The '''1954–55 [[Super League Greece|Panhellenic Championship]]''' was the 19th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece.  [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] won their 11th championship (2 consecutive) unbeaten having 19 wins out of 20 total games and only one draw against [[Panathinaikos F.C.|Panathinaikos]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sport24.gr/football/i-lista-ton-protathliton-elladas.7922743.html|title=Η λίστα των πρωταθλητών Ελλάδας|website=sport24.gr}}</ref>

The 6 clubs that participated in the final stage were as follows:
*'''[[Athens Football Clubs Association|Athenian]] Championship''': The first 2 teams of the ranking.
*'''[[Piraeus Football Clubs Association|Piraeus']] Championship''': The champion.
*'''[[Macedonia Football Clubs Association|Macedonian]] Championship''': The champion.
*'''Regional Championship''': The 2 winners (North and South group).

The qualifying round matches took place from 10 October 1954 to 13 February 1955, while the final phase took place from 20 February to 17 July 1955. The point system was: ''Win: 3 points'' - ''Draw: 2 points'' - ''Loss: 1 point''.
